blurple.$description: Blurple — Secondary filled CTA ("Open Discord in your browser"), brand glow in the page gradient, footer wash — Discord's signature brand color; declared on the site as --blurple

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Page canvas (body background) — the saturated dark indigo every section sits on; a starfield/gradient texture is layered over it

white.$description: White — All text on the indigo canvas, primary CTA fill, nav pill and nav button fill — the dominant foreground and the highest-emphasis control surface

black.$description: Black — Text on white controls (nav button, logo pill), footer base color beneath the footer gradient image

not-quite-black.$description: Not Quite Black — Label text on the white hero download button; declared on the site as --not-quite-black

fog.$description: Fog — Hover fill of the white nav button — the only measured hover color on a filled control

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Skip-to-content link background; the same vivid green family fills green media insets inside feature blocks

spring-green.$description: Spring Green — Declared brand accent (--spring-green) — link hover accent and media-inset fills; not used for controls on the homepage

fuchsia.$description: Fuchsia — Declared brand accent (--fuchsia) — magenta glow in media-inset gradients and link hover accent

yellow.$description: Yellow — Declared brand accent (--yellow) — link hover accent only; absent from homepage surfaces

white-70.$description: White 70 — Footer column headings and field labels (Product, Company, Language, Social) — muted white on indigo

white-10.$description: White 10 — Language select fill in the footer — translucent control surface on dark

abc-ginto-discord-nord.$description: All headings, the hero headline, the marquee band and the wordmark. An extra-wide, extra-bold grotesque always set in uppercase with tight leading (0.86–0.93 on stacked headlines) and -0.01em tracking. Weights 700 and 800 only.

abc-ginto-discord.$description: Body copy, nav links, button labels, footer links and labels. Weight 400 for reading text and large buttons, 500 for nav links and the compact nav button. Slight positive tracking (0.25–0.32px) at 20px.

base-2.$description: Nav links and nav button label at 16px

base-3.$description: Footer column headings and field labels at 16px (70% white)

xl.$description: Hero and feature-block paragraph at 20px (0.32px tracking measured in hero)

xl-2.$description: Large CTA button label at 20px (0.25px tracking)

4xl.$description: Feature-block heading at 36px, uppercase Fluid: clamp() reaches full size at 1440px.

5xl.$description: Centered closing heading at 48px, uppercase Fluid: clamp() reaches full size at 1280px.

5xl-2.$description: Hero h1 at 56px, uppercase Fluid: clamp() reaches full size at 1440px.

5xl-3.$description: Marquee band words at 61px, uppercase (line box is 25px; glyphs overflow it by design) Fluid: clamp() reaches full size at 1440px.

deep-indigo-canvas.$description: Surface level 0: Page background — saturated dark indigo with starfield texture

glass-block.$description: Surface level 1: Feature blocks — translucent white gradient (135deg, starting at 20% white) over a glass texture with 10px backdrop blur

white-control.$description: Surface level 2: Primary buttons, nav pill, nav button — solid white controls

blurple-action.$description: Surface level 3: Secondary filled CTA — the only solid brand-color control surface
